label: RBI repo rate
note: The rate at which the RBI lends to banks. Raised to fight rising prices; the first rise since February 2023.
source: RBI policy, as reported by PTI

label: Retail inflation (CPI)
note: How fast prices are rising for households. The RBI aims for 4%. The September figure comes out on Monday 12 Oct.

label: US interest rate (Fed)
note: Set by the US Federal Reserve, the US central bank. Vote was 12–0; first rise since July 2023. Next decision 27–28 Oct.

label: Sensex
note: India's main share-market index. It rose after two days of falls. Small chart: closing levels on 30 Sep, 8 Oct and 9 Oct. The Nifty 50 closed at 22,520 (+1.3%).

label: Crude oil (Brent)
note: The world benchmark oil price. Above $100 because of the Iran war; it eased after Trump's statement on 8 Oct.

label: Rupee per dollar
change: A dollar costs about 8% more rupees than a year ago
note: Level when trading opened on 1 Oct 2026. A year earlier it was 88.67 (13 Oct 2025, All India Radio). I could not find a confirmed figure for 9 Oct.
source: Kotak Neo; year-ago level from AIR

label: GDP growth
note: How fast the economy grew. Faster than the RBI expected. The RBI's forecast for the full year is 7.1%.

label: GST collected, September
note: GST on imports rose 25.9%; GST on sales within India rose 10.1%. Early figures that may be revised.
source: Government data, as reported by Business Today

label: Foreign investors in Indian shares, Sep
change: They sold more than they bought
note: NSDL data. Shows money leaving India's share market.
source: NSDL data, as reported by Kotak Neo

label: India's dollar reserves
change: Down $14.88 bn in the week to 18 Sep
note: Foreign currency held by the RBI. The biggest weekly fall in about two years, reportedly because the RBI sold dollars to support the rupee.
source: RBI data, as reported by Economic Times and Bloomberg (via Digg)
